name: Sawamura Mitsuo
source:
He likes receptive older women and has a faint crush on his aunt, Rika.

He is weak-willed and is unable to rebel when others take an overbearing attitude toward her.

She still calls her mother Anna "Mama".

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=397805]getchu[/url]]
